title: Benefits | Paramount
description: Paramount is one of the world’s leading producers of premium entertainment content that connects billions of people in nearly every country in the world.

headings.text: FOLLOW US FOR A GLIMPSE INTO LIFE AT PARAMOUNT

body: 401(k) plan with a company match for eligible employees starting on their first date of employment.
Financial Wellness Planning: Services provided by EY at no cost to employees.
Employee Assistance Fund: Receive assistance with the costs of emergency evacuation, disaster recovery, or unexpected events such as a sudden illness, car accident, or loss of a partner.
We want you to stay connected to your career goals and your community, with ways to support your continued education as well as extend your charitable efforts.
A few of the benefits we offer include:
Tuition Assistance: Reimbursement up to $10,000 per calendar year for undergraduate/graduate degrees, certifications, and certificates that are aligned to current or future job roles.
College Coach Program: Help your dependents choose the best college savings plan, navigate college admissions, and manage existing education debt.
Employee Matching Gift Program: Paramount will match charitable donations to $1,000/year — doubling your impact.
Explore the wide range of benefits and resources available to support the physical, financial and emotional well-being of you and your family.
We prioritize the holistic well-being of our employees by offering a diverse range of wellness programs designed to enhance physical, mental, and emotional health.
Employee Assistance Programs (EAP) Up to 8 sessions of short-term confidential counseling, available over the phone and onsite at select office locations.

Some of our programs for employees and their families include:

Bright Horizons®: Back-up child care for children 3 months through 13 years of age. The back-up elder care program provides in-home services that older adults may need, such as meal preparation, bathing and companion services.
Adoption Assistance: Paramount will reimburse up to $30,000 (lifetime maximum) of eligible and documented expenses to cover the cost of adoption by an eligible employee.
Surrogacy Benefit: Paramount will reimburse up to $40,000 (lifetime maximum) of eligible and documented expenses associated with surrogacy parenting.

Paid Parental Leave & Paid Caregiving Leave: Employees are eligible for paid parental leave for birth of a child (in addition to paid short-term disability), adoption and foster care. Eligible employees are eligible for up to 6 weeks of paid FMLA leave to care for an immediate family member.
Bicycle Commuter Reimbursement Reimbursement up to $180/year for bicycle commuting costs, including monthly bike share memberships.
